variables.log_returns.description.zh-CN: 由相邻复权净值比值的自然对数计算得到的收益率序列。
variables.log_returns.description.en-US: Log returns calculated as the natural logarithm of adjacent adjusted NAV ratios.

variables.adjusted_nav.description.zh-CN: 窗口内真实复权净值水平；用于事后研究，不宣称具备历史调整因子时点性。
variables.adjusted_nav.description.en-US: Observed adjusted NAV levels in the window, for retrospective research. Historical point-in-time adjustment factors are not guaranteed.

variables.market_open.description.zh-CN: ETF 未复权日开盘价，不得与复权净值混用价格口径。
variables.market_open.description.en-US: Unadjusted ETF daily opening price. Do not mix its price basis with adjusted NAV.

variables.previous_close.description.zh-CN: ETF 日行情中的前收盘价。
variables.previous_close.description.en-US: Previous closing price from ETF daily market data.

variables.price_change.description.zh-CN: ETF 收盘价相对前收盘价的变动额。
variables.price_change.description.en-US: Change in ETF closing price relative to the previous close.

variables.price_return.description.zh-CN: 行情来源的百分比涨跌幅除以 100，转换为小数收益率。
variables.price_return.description.en-US: The market-data percentage change divided by 100, expressed as a decimal return.

variables.volume.description.zh-CN: ETF 日成交量，原始单位由数据来源契约决定。
variables.volume.description.en-US: ETF daily trading volume, in the units specified by the source data contract.

variables.turnover_amount.description.zh-CN: ETF 日成交额，原始单位由数据来源契约决定。
variables.turnover_amount.description.en-US: ETF daily trading amount, in the units specified by the source data contract.

variables.unit_nav.description.zh-CN: 基金单位净值，仅在引用窗口内字段完整时可用。
variables.unit_nav.description.en-US: Fund unit NAV, available only when the field is complete in the referenced window.

variables.accumulated_nav.description.zh-CN: 基金累计净值，仅在引用窗口内字段完整时可用。
variables.accumulated_nav.description.en-US: Fund accumulated NAV, available only when the field is complete in the referenced window.

variables.accumulated_dividend.descripti.zh-CN: 累计分红字段，数据稀疏时返回不可用，不进行填充。
variables.accumulated_dividend.descripti.en-US: Accumulated distributions. Sparse data is reported as unavailable, not filled.

variables.net_asset.description.zh-CN: 基金净资产，按公告可得日截断且不填充。
variables.net_asset.description.en-US: Fund net assets, restricted by announcement availability dates and never filled.

variables.total_net_asset.description.zh-CN: 基金资产总额，按公告可得日截断且不填充。
variables.total_net_asset.description.en-US: Fund total assets, restricted by announcement availability dates and never filled.

variables.observation_count.description.zh-CN: 当前窗口实际收益观察数。
variables.observation_count.description.en-US: Actual number of return observations in the current window.

variables.window_elapsed_days.descriptio.zh-CN: 当前窗口实际起止日之间的自然日数，不等于用户选择的周期标签。
variables.window_elapsed_days.descriptio.en-US: Calendar days between the actual window endpoints, not the requested period label.

variables.risk_free_return_window.descri.zh-CN: 根据年化无风险利率和窗口实际自然日数换算的累计收益。
variables.risk_free_return_window.descri.en-US: Cumulative risk-free return calculated from the annual rate and actual calendar days in the window.

variables.asset_returns.description.zh-CN: 严格按共同日期对齐后的多资产普通收益矩阵。
variables.asset_returns.description.en-US: Multi-asset simple return matrix aligned strictly to common dates.

variables.asset_log_returns.description.zh-CN: 严格按共同日期对齐后的多资产对数收益矩阵。
variables.asset_log_returns.description.en-US: Multi-asset log return matrix aligned strictly to common dates.

variables.portfolio_returns.description.zh-CN: 按每日生效权重和各底层产品当日收益汇总的组合收益率序列。
variables.portfolio_returns.description.en-US: Portfolio return series aggregated from the weights effective each day and underlying product returns.

variables.asset_weights.description.zh-CN: 当前快照末期资产权重，只用于当前截面风险或情景估算，不代表历史区间权重。
variables.asset_weights.description.en-US: End-of-snapshot asset weights for current cross-sectional risk or scenario estimates, not historical weights.

variables.weight_path.description.zh-CN: 逐日实际生效的资产权重路径。
variables.weight_path.description.en-US: Daily path of the asset weights actually in effect.

variables.benchmark_returns.description.zh-CN: 与研究收益按共同日期对齐的可选基准收益率。
variables.benchmark_returns.description.en-US: Optional benchmark returns aligned to common dates with the research returns.

variables.annual_risk_free_rate_decimal..zh-CN: 指标配置中的年化无风险收益率，以小数表示。
variables.annual_risk_free_rate_decimal..en-US: Annual risk-free return from the indicator configuration, expressed as a decimal.

operators.minimum.description.zh-CN: 逐元素选择输入 A 与输入 B 的较小值。
operators.minimum.description.en-US: Select the smaller of inputs A and B at each element.

operators.maximum.description.zh-CN: 逐元素选择输入 A 与输入 B 的较大值。
operators.maximum.description.en-US: Select the larger of inputs A and B at each element.

operators.negate.description.zh-CN: 逐元素改变输入的符号。
operators.negate.description.en-US: Reverse the sign of each input element.

operators.absolute.description.zh-CN: 逐元素计算输入的绝对值。
operators.absolute.description.en-US: Compute the absolute value of each input element.

operators.sqrt.description.zh-CN: 逐元素计算非负输入的平方根。
operators.sqrt.description.en-US: Compute the square root of each nonnegative input element.

operators.clip.description.zh-CN: 按数值下界与上界逐元素限幅，不改变计算周期或样本窗口。
operators.clip.description.en-US: Clip each value to the lower and upper bounds without changing the calculation period or sample window.

operators.sum.description.zh-CN: 将时间序列、向量或矩阵的全部元素相加，得到单个数值。
operators.sum.description.en-US: Sum every element of a time series, vector or matrix into one number.

operators.product.description.zh-CN: 将时间序列、向量或矩阵的全部元素相乘，得到单个数值。
operators.product.description.en-US: Multiply every element of a time series, vector or matrix into one number.

operators.mean.description.zh-CN: 计算时间序列、向量或矩阵全部元素的算术平均值。
operators.mean.description.en-US: Compute the arithmetic mean of all elements of a time series, vector or matrix.

operators.variance.description.zh-CN: 计算全部元素的方差，自由度修正由参数决定。
operators.variance.description.en-US: Compute the variance of all elements using the specified degrees-of-freedom adjustment.

operators.std.description.zh-CN: 计算全部元素的标准差，自由度修正由参数决定。
operators.std.description.en-US: Compute the standard deviation of all elements using the specified degrees-of-freedom adjustment.

operators.rolling_min.description.zh-CN: 沿时间轴按固定窗口取得最小值。
operators.rolling_min.description.en-US: Find the minimum over a fixed window along the time axis.

operators.rolling_max.description.zh-CN: 沿时间轴按固定窗口取得最大值。
operators.rolling_max.description.en-US: Find the maximum over a fixed window along the time axis.

operators.recursive_smooth.description.zh-CN: 按固定平滑期数和初始值进行因果递归平滑。
operators.recursive_smooth.description.en-US: Apply causal recursive smoothing with a fixed smoothing period and initial value.

operators.divide_or_default.description.zh-CN: 逐元素相除，分母为零或接近零时返回指定默认值。
operators.divide_or_default.description.en-US: Divide each numerator by its denominator, returning the specified default for zero or near-zero denominators.

operators.min_value.description.zh-CN: 取得时间序列、向量或矩阵全部元素中的最小值。
operators.min_value.description.en-US: Find the minimum of all elements of a time series, vector or matrix.

operators.max_value.description.zh-CN: 取得时间序列、向量或矩阵全部元素中的最大值。
operators.max_value.description.en-US: Find the maximum of all elements of a time series, vector or matrix.

operators.cumulative_sum.description.zh-CN: 沿一维输入的对齐维度计算累计和。
operators.cumulative_sum.description.en-US: Compute a cumulative sum along the one-dimensional input axis.

operators.cumulative_product.description.zh-CN: 沿一维输入的对齐维度计算累计乘积。
operators.cumulative_product.description.en-US: Compute a cumulative product along the one-dimensional input axis.

operators.last.description.zh-CN: 取得时间序列或向量的最后一个元素。
operators.last.description.en-US: Return the last element of a time series or vector.

operators.sum_time.description.zh-CN: 沿矩阵时间轴求和，保留资产轴。
operators.sum_time.description.en-US: Sum along the matrix time axis, retaining the asset axis.

operators.sum_asset.description.zh-CN: 沿矩阵资产轴求和，保留时间轴。
operators.sum_asset.description.en-US: Sum along the matrix asset axis, retaining the time axis.

operators.product_time.description.zh-CN: 沿矩阵时间轴累乘，保留资产轴。
operators.product_time.description.en-US: Multiply along the matrix time axis, retaining the asset axis.

operators.product_asset.description.zh-CN: 沿矩阵资产轴累乘，保留时间轴。
operators.product_asset.description.en-US: Multiply along the matrix asset axis, retaining the time axis.

operators.mean_time.description.zh-CN: 沿矩阵时间轴计算平均值，输出资产向量。
operators.mean_time.description.en-US: Average over the time axis, returning an asset vector.

operators.mean_asset.description.zh-CN: 沿矩阵资产轴计算平均值，输出时间序列。
operators.mean_asset.description.en-US: Average over the asset axis, returning a time series.

operators.variance_time.description.zh-CN: 沿矩阵时间轴计算方差，输出资产向量。
operators.variance_time.description.en-US: Compute variance over the time axis, returning an asset vector.

operators.variance_asset.description.zh-CN: 沿矩阵资产轴计算方差，输出时间序列。
operators.variance_asset.description.en-US: Compute variance over the asset axis, returning a time series.

operators.std_time.description.zh-CN: 沿矩阵时间轴计算标准差，输出资产向量。
operators.std_time.description.en-US: Compute standard deviation over the time axis, returning an asset vector.

operators.std_asset.description.zh-CN: 沿矩阵资产轴计算标准差，输出时间序列。
operators.std_asset.description.en-US: Compute standard deviation over the asset axis, returning a time series.

operators.min_time.description.zh-CN: 沿矩阵时间轴取最小值，输出资产向量。
operators.min_time.description.en-US: Find minima over the time axis, returning an asset vector.

operators.min_asset.description.zh-CN: 沿矩阵资产轴取最小值，输出时间序列。
operators.min_asset.description.en-US: Find minima over the asset axis, returning a time series.

operators.max_time.description.zh-CN: 沿矩阵时间轴取最大值，输出资产向量。
operators.max_time.description.en-US: Find maxima over the time axis, returning an asset vector.

operators.max_asset.description.zh-CN: 沿矩阵资产轴取最大值，输出时间序列。
operators.max_asset.description.en-US: Find maxima over the asset axis, returning a time series.

operators.transpose.description.zh-CN: 交换矩阵的两个对齐维度。
operators.transpose.description.en-US: Swap the two named axes of a matrix.

operators.dot.description.zh-CN: 对两个同轴一维输入执行点积，得到单个数值。
operators.dot.description.en-US: Take the dot product of two one-dimensional inputs on the same axis, returning a number.

operators.outer.description.zh-CN: 对两个资产向量计算外积。
operators.outer.description.en-US: Compute the outer product of two asset vectors.

operators.matmul.description.zh-CN: 沿匹配的内部维度执行矩阵与矩阵相乘。
operators.matmul.description.en-US: Multiply two matrices whose inner named axes match.

operators.matvec.description.zh-CN: 沿匹配的内部维度执行矩阵与向量相乘。
operators.matvec.description.en-US: Multiply a matrix by a vector with a matching inner named axis.

operators.diag.description.zh-CN: 从资产向量构造对角矩阵，或提取方阵对角线。
operators.diag.description.en-US: Construct a diagonal matrix from an asset vector, or extract a square matrix diagonal.

operators.trace.description.en-US: Sum the main diagonal of a square matrix.

operators.solve.description.zh-CN: 求解线性方程，不显式计算矩阵逆。
operators.solve.description.en-US: Solve a linear system without explicitly calculating a matrix inverse.

operators.covariance.description.zh-CN: 按共同时间轴计算样本协方差或协方差矩阵。
operators.covariance.description.en-US: Compute sample covariance or a covariance matrix on the common time axis.

operators.correlation.description.zh-CN: 按共同时间轴计算皮尔逊相关系数或相关矩阵。
operators.correlation.description.en-US: Compute Pearson correlation or a correlation matrix on the common time axis.

operators.quadratic_form.description.zh-CN: 计算向量与矩阵的二次型。
operators.quadratic_form.description.en-US: Compute the quadratic form of a vector and matrix.

operators.log.description.zh-CN: 逐元素计算严格正、无量纲输入的自然对数。
operators.log.description.en-US: Compute natural logarithms of strictly positive, dimensionless inputs.

operators.exp.description.zh-CN: 逐元素计算无量纲输入的自然指数。
operators.exp.description.en-US: Compute the natural exponential of each dimensionless input.

operators.reciprocal.description.zh-CN: 逐元素计算倒数，对零值返回诊断。
operators.reciprocal.description.en-US: Compute reciprocals element by element, reporting diagnostics for zeros.

operators.sign.description.zh-CN: 逐元素返回负一、零或正一。
operators.sign.description.en-US: Return minus one, zero or one for the sign of each input.

operators.equal.description.zh-CN: 逐元素判断两个输入是否相等，允许单个数值广播，输出是／否。
operators.equal.description.en-US: Test elementwise equality, allowing scalar broadcasting, and return true or false.

operators.not_equal.description.zh-CN: 逐元素判断两个输入是否不相等，允许单个数值广播，输出是／否。
operators.not_equal.description.en-US: Test elementwise inequality, allowing scalar broadcasting, and return true or false.

operators.less_equal.description.zh-CN: 逐元素判断输入 A 是否小于等于输入 B，输出是／否。
operators.less_equal.description.en-US: Test whether input A is less than or equal to input B at each element.

operators.greater_than.description.zh-CN: 逐元素判断输入 A 是否大于输入 B，输出是／否。
operators.greater_than.description.en-US: Test whether input A is greater than input B at each element.

operators.greater_equal.description.zh-CN: 逐元素判断输入 A 是否大于等于输入 B，输出是／否。
operators.greater_equal.description.en-US: Test whether input A is greater than or equal to input B at each element.

operators.logical_and.description.zh-CN: 对两组相同形状的判断条件执行逻辑与。
operators.logical_and.description.en-US: Apply logical AND to two condition arrays of the same shape.

operators.logical_or.description.zh-CN: 对两组相同形状的判断条件执行逻辑或。
operators.logical_or.description.en-US: Apply logical OR to two condition arrays of the same shape.

operators.where.description.zh-CN: 根据判断条件，在两个兼容的数值输入之间逐元素选择。
operators.where.description.en-US: Use conditions to select elements from two compatible numerical inputs.

operators.first.description.zh-CN: 取得时间序列或资产向量的第一个元素。
operators.first.description.en-US: Return the first element of a time series or asset vector.

operators.length.description.zh-CN: 返回时间序列或资产向量的元素数量。
operators.length.description.en-US: Return the number of elements in a time series or asset vector.

operators.lag.description.zh-CN: 按给定期数移除尾部元素，生成用于滞后比较的序列。
operators.lag.description.en-US: Remove the specified number of trailing observations to form a series for lagged comparison.

operators.difference.description.zh-CN: 计算一维输入中相隔给定期数的差。
operators.difference.description.en-US: Calculate differences between elements separated by the specified number of periods.

operators.median.description.zh-CN: 计算数值数组全部元素的中位数。
operators.median.description.en-US: Compute the median of every element in the numerical array.

operators.skewness.description.zh-CN: 计算有限样本修正后的偏度。

operators.excess_kurtosis.description.zh-CN: 计算有限样本修正后的超额峰度。
operators.excess_kurtosis.description.en-US: Compute excess kurtosis with finite-sample correction.

operators.mean_absolute_deviation.descri.zh-CN: 计算元素相对算术平均值的平均绝对偏差。
operators.mean_absolute_deviation.descri.en-US: Compute the mean absolute deviation from the arithmetic mean.

operators.root_mean_square.description.zh-CN: 计算元素平方平均值的平方根。
operators.root_mean_square.description.en-US: Compute the square root of the mean of squared elements.

operators.cumulative_max.description.zh-CN: 沿一维输入生成截至各位置的累计最大值。
operators.cumulative_max.description.en-US: Compute the running maximum up to each position of the one-dimensional input.

operators.cumulative_min.description.zh-CN: 沿一维输入生成截至各位置的累计最小值。
operators.cumulative_min.description.en-US: Compute the running minimum up to each position of the one-dimensional input.

operators.drawdown_series.description.zh-CN: 计算净值或价格相对当期历史峰值的有符号回撤；峰值处为零，低于峰值时为负。
operators.drawdown_series.description.en-US: Compute signed drawdowns from the historical peak available at each point: zero at peaks and negative below them.

operators.new_high_mask.description.zh-CN: 首个有效值计为创新高；此后仅严格超过历史峰值时成立，相同峰值不重复计数。
operators.new_high_mask.description.en-US: The first valid value is a new high. Later values count only when strictly above the previous peak, not when equal.

operators.argmin.description.zh-CN: 返回最小元素从零开始的位置。
operators.argmin.description.en-US: Return the zero-based position of the minimum element.

operators.argmax.description.zh-CN: 返回最大元素从零开始的位置。
operators.argmax.description.en-US: Return the zero-based position of the maximum element.

operators.quantile.description.zh-CN: 按给定概率计算全部元素的经验分位数。
operators.quantile.description.en-US: Compute the empirical quantile of all elements at the specified probability.

operators.sum_where.description.zh-CN: 仅对判断条件成立的元素求和。
operators.sum_where.description.en-US: Sum only the elements whose condition is true.

operators.mean_where.description.zh-CN: 仅对判断条件成立的元素计算平均值。
operators.mean_where.description.en-US: Average only the elements whose condition is true.

operators.variance_where.description.zh-CN: 仅对判断条件成立的元素计算方差。
operators.variance_where.description.en-US: Compute variance using only elements whose condition is true.

operators.std_where.description.zh-CN: 仅对判断条件成立的元素计算标准差。
operators.std_where.description.en-US: Compute standard deviation using only elements whose condition is true.

operators.min_where.description.zh-CN: 仅在判断条件成立的元素中取最小值。
operators.min_where.description.en-US: Find the minimum among elements whose condition is true.

operators.max_where.description.zh-CN: 仅在判断条件成立的元素中取最大值。
operators.max_where.description.en-US: Find the maximum among elements whose condition is true.

operators.median_where.description.zh-CN: 仅对判断条件成立的元素计算中位数。
operators.median_where.description.en-US: Compute the median using only elements whose condition is true.

operators.quantile_where.description.zh-CN: 仅对判断条件成立的元素计算经验分位数。
operators.quantile_where.description.en-US: Compute the empirical quantile using only elements whose condition is true.

operators.count_true.description.zh-CN: 统计判断条件成立的元素数量。
operators.count_true.description.en-US: Count the elements whose condition is true.

operators.max_consecutive_true.descripti.zh-CN: 计算一维判断序列中最长连续成立的长度。
operators.max_consecutive_true.descripti.en-US: Find the longest consecutive run of true conditions in a one-dimensional sequence.

operators.linear_slope.description.zh-CN: 计算一元普通最小二乘回归的斜率。
operators.linear_slope.description.en-US: Compute the slope of a simple ordinary least-squares regression.

operators.linear_intercept.description.zh-CN: 计算一元普通最小二乘回归的截距。
operators.linear_intercept.description.en-US: Compute the intercept of a simple ordinary least-squares regression.

operators.linear_r_squared.description.zh-CN: 计算一元普通最小二乘回归的决定系数。
operators.linear_r_squared.description.en-US: Compute the coefficient of determination of a simple ordinary least-squares regression.

operators.regression_standard_error.desc.zh-CN: 计算一元普通最小二乘回归的残差标准误。
operators.regression_standard_error.desc.en-US: Compute the residual standard error of a simple ordinary least-squares regression.

operators.normal_pdf.description.zh-CN: 逐元素计算标准正态分布的概率密度。
operators.normal_pdf.description.en-US: Evaluate the standard normal probability density at each element.

operators.normal_ppf.description.zh-CN: 逐元素计算严格位于零和一之间的概率所对应的标准正态分位数。
operators.normal_ppf.description.en-US: Evaluate standard normal quantiles for probabilities strictly between zero and one.

valueTypes.same.zh-CN: 与输入相同的数据类型

variables.risk_free_rate_per_observation.zh-CN: 单观察期无风险收益率

variables.returns.description.zh-CN: 相邻有效复权净值的普通收益率。
variables.returns.description.en-US: Simple returns between valid adjacent adjusted NAV observations.

variables.periods_per_year.description.zh-CN: 年化计算使用的每年观察期数。
variables.periods_per_year.description.en-US: Number of observation periods per year used for annualization.

variables.risk_free_rate_per_observation.zh-CN: 与单个收益观察期对应的无风险收益率。
variables.risk_free_rate_per_observation.en-US: Risk-free return corresponding to one return observation period.

operators.value_at.description.zh-CN: 按零基位置取一个值，保留日期或数值量纲。缺失或无效位置不填零。
operators.value_at.description.en-US: Select one element by a zero-based position and preserve its date or numeric measure. Invalid positions remain unavailable.

operators.linear_fit.description.zh-CN: 同一样本只拟合一次；继续连接字段提取算子构建独立指标。
operators.linear_fit.description.en-US: Fit once on the same observations and use field projections to build independent metrics.

operators.last_drawdown_interval.label.zh-CN: 最后一次最大回撤区间

operators.add.description.zh-CN: 对两个输入逐元素相加，只有单个数值可广播。
operators.add.description.en-US: Add matching elements; only scalar inputs may be broadcast.

operators.subtract.description.zh-CN: 对两个输入逐元素相减，只有单个数值可广播。
operators.subtract.description.en-US: Subtract matching elements; only scalar inputs may be broadcast.

operators.multiply.description.zh-CN: 对两个输入逐元素相乘，只有单个数值可广播。
operators.multiply.description.en-US: Multiply matching elements; only scalar inputs may be broadcast.

operators.divide.description.zh-CN: 逐元素相除，分母为零或接近零时返回诊断。
operators.divide.description.en-US: Divide matching elements; zero or near-zero denominators produce a diagnostic.

operators.power.description.en-US: Raise each base value to the specified exponent.

operators.rolling_mean.description.zh-CN: 沿时间轴按固定窗口计算平均值，样本不足时保留缺失。
operators.rolling_mean.description.en-US: Compute a fixed-window mean along time; insufficient observations remain missing.

operators.rolling_std.description.zh-CN: 按固定窗口计算标准差，自由度和最少观察数固定在定义中。
operators.rolling_std.description.en-US: Compute a fixed-window standard deviation with degrees of freedom and minimum observations fixed in the definition.

operators.less_than.description.zh-CN: 逐元素判断输入 A 是否小于输入 B，输出是／否。
operators.less_than.description.en-US: Check whether each value of input A is less than input B, returning true or false.
